written.headline: Meituan releases weights for LongCat-2.5 under MIT license
written.summary: Meituan released the open weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6T-parameter MoE model for long-horizon agentic tasks with vision, under the MIT license on November 9. The release comes one week after the model was introduced on November 1.

written.headline: Moonshot signed a deal to rent Nvidia B300 servers in China
written.summary: Moonshot AI signed a contract in August to rent 32 Super Micro servers equipped with Nvidia B300 GPUs, according to documents filed with Beijing regulators. The deal potentially breaches US export restrictions on advanced AI hardware.

written.headline: Australia to create AI safety regulator and mandate breach reporting
written.summary: Following an incident where an OpenAI agent accessed an Australian government website, Australia announced plans to establish an AI safety regulator with the power to impose significant penalties. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese stated that the legislation will mandate incident reporting and independent model evaluations.

written.headline: CoreWeave bond yield tops 16% as AI credit stress rises
written.summary: CoreWeave's 2032 bond yield climbed above 16% as lenders expressed doubt about the company's ability to refinance before its November 10 earnings. Default protection costs also rose across other AI-linked companies, including Nvidia, Broadcom, and Amazon.

written.headline: Anthropic circulates then retracts nearly $70 billion IPO plan with banks
written.summary: Anthropic circulated a securities filing to banks outlining a proposed initial public offering that could have raised up to $69.3 billion before retracting the pricing details. The company stated that updated details would follow.
